title: The ordinary diversity bound for intersecting uniform hypergraphs
statement:
Let $\mathcal{F}\subset \binom{[n]}{k}$ be an intersecting family, and let $\gamma(\mathcal{F})$ denote its ordinary diversity. Suppose that $n>4k$. **Ordinary diversity conjecture.**

$$
\gamma(\mathcal{F})\leq \binom{n-3}{k-2}.
$$

This is posed as an open problem concerning the ordinary diversity of intersecting families. It asks for a sharp upper bound under the linear condition $n>4k$; the supplied text does not report a resolution.
source_name: Peter Frankl and Jian Wang, “On the C-diversity of intersecting hypergraphs”, arXiv:2308.14028 (2024).
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2018–2023). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1804.11269](https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.11269).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.14028

Status: **open** according to the source (as of August 2023). “Let us conclude this paper by a open problem concerning the ordinary diversity.”
